description: This file contains a set of shell functions and scripts related to managing GitHub pull requests, including URL resolution, push operations, branch verification, and fallback mechanisms using GraphQL API. It primarily orchestrates interactions with Git and GitHub to facilitate PR branch updates and verification.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url
methods.description: Resolves the URL for the PR head repository, either from environment variables or fallback logic.

methods.name: graphql_push_to_fork
methods.description: Performs a push of local diffs to a forked repository via GitHub GraphQL API, supporting large files and specific file types.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url_https
methods.description: Provides the HTTPS URL for the PR head repository, similar to resolve_head_push_url but specifically for HTTPS.

methods.name: verify_pr_head_branch_matches_expected
methods.description: Checks if the current PR head branch matches the expected branch name.

methods.name: setup_prhead_remote
methods.description: Sets up the 'prhead' remote in Git pointing to the PR head repository URL.

methods.name: resolve_prhead_remote_sha
methods.description: Resolves the SHA of the remote PR head branch, with fallback to HTTPS URL if remote fetch fails.

methods.name: push_prep_head_to_pr_branch
methods.description: Pushes the local prep head to the PR branch, handling lease conflicts, permissions, and potential fallback via GraphQL API, and verifying the push success.
